::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** 31 March 1871 [changed from mistken 31 march 1817]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS UCLA: collection 100: box 95
:::

Dear [Mr Craik](people/person_379.qmd),

I am much obliged for the cheque, I feel as if I hardly deserved it after all the trouble I have given [Mr Freeman](people/person_523.qmd).[^1]

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Perhaps the Royal Needles Hotel, Alum Bay, from which Marconi sent the first wireless transmission in 1897.
[^2]: Catharine Elgie, wife of the curate of Otterbourne.
